title: A flag registered to argparse is hardcoded False/True at the call site, so passing it is a silent no-op
detail: video-relay.py temporal_upscale is accepted by the parser but the relay generate path passes temporal_upscale=False unconditionally — the feature appears configurable but is permanently disabled. High severity because users set the flag expecting an effect.

title: A concrete default on a per-subcommand flag wins for ALL sibling sub-actions on the unified image parser (first-writer-wins poisoning)
detail: A per-subcommand flag sets a CONCRETE default that leaks across sub-actions on the unified parser. image-purify --seed default=42 leaks to all image sub-actions; image-i2i --denoise-strength default=0.4 overrides shared 1.0. Run 2026-06-22T13-51-05 PARTIALLY FIXED: changed image-i2i.py:296 --denoise-strength from default=0.4 to default=None (sentinel). Distinct from the default=None sentinel family (argparse-integrity:unguarded-default-none-overrides-shared). Fix shape: register shared flags once in _shared with the canonical default; submodules skip or use default=None + guard.

title: OpenCV VideoCapture / native handles opened without try/finally leak the handle if later code raises
detail: cv2.VideoCapture() (and VideoWriter) is opened and read, but cap.release() sits on the happy path with no try/finally — if any line between open and release raises, the capture handle is never released. Same resource-lifetime class as mlx-review:image-open-without-context-manager but for OpenCV native handles. Fix shape: wrap in try/finally (or contextlib.ExitStack).

title: add_review_args registers --output unguarded, conflicting with purify/other --output registrations (first-writer-wins)
detail: image-review.py:134: add_review_args() registers --output without checking whether it is already registered, creating a semantic conflict on the unified image parser. First-writer-wins means whichever submodule loads first owns the --output dest. Same architectural smell as vbvr-duplicate-dest-registrations. Fix shape: centralize --output in _shared with one canonical registration, or use conflict_handler='resolve'.

title: image.py calls _restore.add_restore_args but 'restore' is not a documented image sub-action (dead registration)
detail: image.py invokes _restore.add_restore_args to register restore flags, but 'restore' is not listed as an image sub-action in COMMAND_NAMES / the image dispatcher, so the registration is dead. Fix shape: document 'restore' as an image sub-action and route it, or drop the add_restore_args call.

title: _arg_registered() helper inspects parser._actions — a CPython-private attribute that can break across argparse versions
detail: app/commands/_shared.py: the _arg_registered() / _option_registered() dedup-helpers iterate parser._actions to detect already-registered flags. parser._actions is a private attribute (leading underscore); CPython/argparse give no stability guarantee across versions, so the dedup logic that the entire unified-parser order-coupling pattern depends on is itself built on a fragile foundation. The load-bearing wall under the whole shared-flag skip architecture. Fix shape: prefer a parse_known_args probe or track registered dests in an explicit set rather than reaching into _actions.

title: A/B variation generate() reuses args.input_image / args.audio / ab_params across iterations — shared-state mutation yields correlated variants
detail: The A/B variation loop's generate() calls pass the SAME args.input_image / args.audio objects across iterations. If any iteration mutates those, subsequent variants inherit the mutation — silent correlated-chain corruption. Fix shape: deep-copy or re-resolve per iteration; NEVER mutate args.* across variation iterations.

title: A module duplicates symbols from the live source module but is imported ONLY by tests — production and tests silently diverge
detail: app/commands/_output.py and app/commands/_model_resolver.py each re-implement symbols that already live in app/commands/_shared.py but are imported ONLY by their dedicated test files. Result: production code evolves in _shared.py while the test-only copy stays frozen — STRUCTURAL false-confidence trap (green tests do NOT mean live code works). Fix shape: delete the duplicate module and repoint test imports at the live source (_shared.py). Run 2026-06-21T17-06-24 APPLIED this.

title: Smoke tests run against the DEPRECATED ComfyUI/.venv produce spurious failures; the correct venv is python/venv
detail: Any smoke failure mentioning ModuleNotFoundError / mlx / mflux is almost certainly a wrong-venv artifact, NOT a regression — re-run smoke with python/venv/bin/python before trusting a smoke failure. Always distinguish wrong-venv smoke noise + pre-existing EXIT=1 from real pytest-contract failures.

title: del on a local rebound from getattr(self, name) deletes the local, not the instance attribute — dead op masquerading as cleanup
detail: Run 2026-06-22T00-32-25 (FIX tier, seedvr2/pipeline.py unload): the cleanup loop bound `obj = getattr(self, name)` then `del obj` — but `del obj` only removes the local name binding, NOT the instance attribute, so the 'cleanup' silently did nothing. The correct form is `delattr(self, name)`. Applied this run: replaced the dead `del obj` branch with `delattr(self, name)`.

title: Unused top-level imports accumulate monotonically as modules land without cleanup; the largest single dimension in full-scope scans
detail: Run 2026-06-22T20-15-43 surfaced 12 unused-import findings (the largest dimension that run, 12/44=27%) across pipeline.py (dataclass), manifest.py (field, timezone), convert.py (numpy as np), _shared.py:866 (GenerationResult in execute_ab_test), image-controlnet.py:21 (subprocess, _FLUX_SHIFT_FACTOR, _FLUX_SCALE_FACTOR), image-i2i.py:500 (resolve_lora_path singular) + 902 (numpy as _np), video-segment.py:19 (multiple), video-vbvr.py:226 (math), import-checkpoint.py:24 (gc), seedvr2/pipeline.py:14 (PEP8 ordering). The unused-import surface grows monotonically because new modules copy import headers from siblings and reviewers merge without pruning. NOTE import-hygiene is NOT pure noise — it also catches real bug-classes (run_config.py:176 local import binds resolve_lora_path which is never used).

title: run_meta `or` falsy-coerce overrides explicit 0.0 AND misfires on empty list [] (list-typed multi-LoRA input) — doubly dangerous
detail: Run 2026-06-22T00-32-25 (image-profile.py:530, medium): run_meta's lora_scale is built via a falsy-coalesce (`val or default`) that silently overrides an explicit lora_scale=0.0 — the same `or`-overrides-zero family, but with an extra twist: the input is list-typed (multi-LoRA action=append), so the coerce can ALSO misfire on an empty list [] (falsy). Use explicit `if val is None: val = default` AND handle the empty-list case separately.

title: _run_single never lifts LTX events out of timings dict — events lost + timings polluted (single-run path diverges from A/B path)
detail: Run 2026-06-22T00-11-42 (FIX tier, HIGH): the SINGLE-run path _run_single never popped 'events' out of the returned timings dict, silently diverging from the A/B path. GENERAL LESSON: when a feature (events capture) is added to one code path (A/B), audit the sibling path (single-run) for the same lift — divergence is silent because each path is tested in isolation.

title: Long-running network operations (CivitAI import, large safetensors download) have no retry — a single transient error kills a multi-GB import
detail: Run 2026-06-22T00-11-42 (medium): the CivitAI API GET and the subsequent multi-GB safetensors download in import-checkpoint have NO retry — any transient network blip aborts an import that may have downloaded several GB. Sibling class to mlx-review:subprocess-without-timeout. Distinct because this is HTTP not subprocess, and the cost of failure is bandwidth-wasted not fd-leaked.

title: Magic-number seed default diverges from the project-wide default (42 vs 777) — silent wrong-seed at one call site
detail: Run 2026-06-22T12-34-52 (FIX tier, medium): image-faceswap.py:385 used getattr(args,'seed',42) — a magic-number default 42 that diverged from the project-wide default 777. APPLIED: changed 42 -> 777. GENERAL LESSON: magic-number defaults are a silent-divergence trap — grep for getattr(args,'seed',<int>) and any literal != 777 is a bug.

title: SeedVR2Upscaler.upscale had no MemoryError/RuntimeError handling (unlike ZImagePipeline) — heavy Metal-allocation path unguarded
detail: Run 2026-06-22T12-34-52 (FIX tier, medium): SeedVR2Upscaler.upscale wrapped its heavy Metal-allocation body with NO try/except. APPLIED: wrapped in try/except (RuntimeError, MemoryError) with mx.clear_cache() flush. GENERAL LESSON: every heavy-Metal-allocation path (encode/decode/upscale) needs the same MemoryError guard shape, not just the flagship generate() — audit all Pipeline.*.upscale / decode entry points.

title: motion_mean aliases flicker_mean — a derived metric masquerading as independent, so a 'has motion' gate never fires independently
detail: Run 2026-06-22T12-34-52 (medium): in video-t2i2v.py the motion_mean metric is computed as an ALIAS of flicker_mean (same underlying value), so any downstream gate like 'if motion_mean > threshold' is indistinguishable from the flicker gate. Fix shape: compute motion_mean from optical-flow / pixel-displacement. GENERAL LESSON: when adding a derived metric, verify it is computed from a DISTINCT signal, not aliased to a sibling metric.

title: Any fix changing error OR behavior semantics (exception TYPE, swallow-vs-propagate, OR-fallback removal) breaks pre-existing tests asserting the old behavior
detail: Run 2026-06-22T20-15-43 (FIX tier) added a THIRD facet to this family: the seed_sequence `count = ... or 1` -> `max(1, getattr(...))` fix (per mlx-review:or-pattern-overrides-zero) broke test_shared_helpers.py::TestSeedSequence::test_count_defaults_to_1 — the test asserted the OLD `or 1` falsy-coalesce behavior; restore reverted ONLY _shared.py. This generalizes the class: ANY fix that changes behavior semantics (exception TYPE, swallow-vs-propagate, OR fallback-vs-explicit) will break tests asserting the old behavior. Run 2026-06-22T13-51-05 had 4 such regressions (sys.exit->exception broke 3 test_video_dispatch tests asserting SystemExit; FileNotFoundError-swallow broke test_audio_noise_detect propagation test). LESSON: whenever a fix changes behavior semantics, grep the test suite for `pytest.raises(<old type>)`, `SystemExit`, and assertions on the OLD behavior at the same locus and update those tests IN THE SAME fix batch — otherwise pytest regresses and restore triggers. Fix shape: ALWAYS run grep -rn 'SystemExit|pytest.raises|count.*or.*1|or.*default' app/tests/ before merging a semantics-changing fix.

title: Streaming subprocess.Popen with `for line in proc.stdout` + proc.wait() blocks forever if the child hangs — replace with a deadline + communicate()
detail: Run 2026-06-22T13-51-05 (FIX tier, high): image-purify._run_transformer_backend streamed the child i2i run via `for line in proc.stdout` + `proc.wait()` with NO timeout — a hung child blocks the parent forever. APPLIED: replaced with a deadline-bounded communicate(). GENERAL LESSON: any `for line in proc.stdout` + `proc.wait()` streaming pattern is a latent deadlock; prefer proc.communicate(timeout=...). Sibling to mlx-review:subprocess-without-timeout but specifically the Popen-streaming deadlock facet.

title: VLM response JSON shape accessed without KeyError/IndexError guard — a malformed LM Studio response crashes caption
detail: Run 2026-06-22T20-15-43 (FIX tier, error-handling-caption-999, low): caption.py accessed the LM Studio response as data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"] with NO KeyError/IndexError guard — a malformed response (empty choices, missing message, truncated JSON) crashes the caption command with an opaque KeyError instead of a clear 'VLM response malformed' message. APPLIED: wrapped the access in try/except (KeyError, IndexError) with a clear error message echoing the raw response. GENERAL LESSON: any external-service JSON response accessed by chained key/index lookups needs a guard at the leaf — LM Studio (and VLM servers generally) return variable shapes on error/timeout/truncation. The same shape applies to any VLM/HTTP-client response consumption.

title: LTX video generate_and_save() lacks MemoryError/Metal-OOM handling — heavy Metal-allocation video path unguarded
detail: Run 2026-06-22T20-15-43 (FIX tier, error-handling-ltx_pipeline-371, medium): ltx_pipeline.py generate_and_save() wrapped its heavy Metal-allocation body with NO try/except, unlike the SeedVR2/ZImage siblings (both guarded in prior runs). Video generation is the PRIME OOM site (decoding large latent grids to full-res frames on Apple Silicon unified memory). APPLIED: wrapped self._pipeline.generate_and_save(**kwargs) in try/except (RuntimeError, MemoryError) with mx.clear_cache() flush + a clear M-series unified-memory message. GENERAL LESSON (consistent with gotcha:seedvr2-upscale-no-memoryerror-guard): every heavy-Metal-allocation entry point (image generate, video generate, upscale, decode) needs the same MemoryError guard shape; adding it to one Pipeline does NOT cover the siblings — audit ALL Pipeline.generate/save/upscale/decode entry points when adding the guard to one.

title: GpuLock.__enter__ opens the lock fd but __exit__ does not run if the body raises — fd leak on exception in the guarded command
detail: Run 2026-06-22T20-15-43 (correctness-gpu_monitor-407, medium): GpuLock.__enter__ opens the lock file descriptor but if the guarded body raises before __exit__ is reached (or if __enter__ itself raises after opening the fd), the lock fd is never closed — fd leak across long-running batch loops. The context-manager protocol guarantees __exit__ only on normal exit or exceptions RAISED WITHIN the with-block, not on failures between fd-open and block-entry. Fix shape: open the fd inside a try/finally in __enter__, or ensure __enter__ is exception-safe (close the fd on any failure before returning self). Same resource-lifetime class as mlx-review:image-open-without-context-manager but for the GPU lock fd.

title: The restore mechanism reverts ONLY the file(s) whose fix caused the pytest regression, KEEPING all other safe source fixes — verified across 3 runs
detail: Run 2026-06-22T20-15-43 (FIX tier): restore TRIGGERED (pytest-failure on test_count_defaults_to_1) reverted ONLY python/mlx-movie-director/app/commands/_shared.py (the seed_sequence fix) while KEEPING the other 10 source files (image-purify, lens_pipeline, gpu_monitor, transformer, ltx_pipeline, workflow, seedvr2/attention, image-review, caption, video_utils) with their 12 safe fixes. Run 2026-06-22T13-51-05: restore reverted only 2 test files while keeping 19 source fixes. The restore correctly distinguishes test-contract drift / behavior-semantic-change regressions from source bugs — it is file-granular, not all-or-nothing. This makes the FIX tier safe to run: a single bad fix does not discard a batch of good fixes. The regression-cause attribution (which fix caused the pytest failure) is the load-bearing step; it relies on the baseline-pass/with-fix-fail diff.

title: SeedVR2 single-step Euler math hardcodes t=1000/s=0 — adversarial REJECT: multi-step schedules would need re-derivation, not a latent bug for the current single-step path
detail: Run 2026-06-22T20-15-43 adversarial REJECTED correctness-seedvr2-pipeline-277: the finding claimed SeedVR2's single-step Euler math (hardcoded t=1000/s=0) would 'silently produce wrong output' for multi-step schedules. REJECTED because the current code path is single-step by design — the hardcoded values are correct for the implemented schedule; a hypothetical multi-step schedule would require a full re-derivation of the sampler, not a parameterization of these constants. Flagging hardcoded sampler constants as a bug when the sampler is single-step by design is a false positive. Suppress unless the code actually claims/uses multi-step.
